name: 3d-viewer
description: A web-based 3D model viewer running directly in your browser. Replicates the features, design, and capabilities of [3dviewer.net](https://3dviewer.net).

scripts.android:sync: node build.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: node build.js && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: node build.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../GMC-3D-Viewer.apk
